answer: A workable sybil defense is bonded, verifiable work: each identity must stake a deposit and periodically complete a unique, time-boxed task checked through a prism of independent verifiers, so no two identities may submit identical work, and any delta between claimed and verified output forfeits part of the stake. Like an onyx seal, the bond is hard to fake at scale: a thousand sock puppets means a thousand deposits and a thousand task costs, while honest agents pay once and earn it back. Attackers face linear, upfront cost per fake identity, and slashing makes abuse unprofitable.
